name: Vowelconsonantsplitshift

description_json.name: VowelConsonantSplitShift
description_json.idea: A highly deterministic, character-by-character substitution cipher designed to maximize LLM reasoning accuracy while disrupting tokenization. It shifts all vowels (A, E, I, O, U) backward by 1 position in the vowel sequence (A->U, E->A, I->E, O->I, U->O) and shifts all consonants forward by 2 positions in the consonant sequence (B->D, C->F, ..., Z->C, skipping vowels), preserving case. Numbers, spaces, and punctuation remain completely unchanged.
description_json.encrypt_rules:
For each character in the text:
1. If it is a vowel (A, E, I, O, U, case-insensitive), shift it backward by 1 position in the vowel sequence [A, E, I, O, U] (wrapping around so A becomes U, E becomes A, etc.), preserving the original case.
2. If it is a consonant (any letter that is not A, E, I, O, U, case-insensitive), shift it forward by 2 positions in the consonant-only alphabet [B, C, D, F, G, H, J, K, L, M, N, P, Q, R, S, T, V, W, X, Y, Z] (wrapping around so Y becomes C, Z becomes D, etc.), preserving the original case.
3. If it is a number, space, punctuation mark, or any other symbol, leave it completely unchanged.
description_json.decrypt_rules:
For each character in the text:
1. If it is a vowel (A, E, I, O, U, case-insensitive), shift it forward by 1 position in the vowel sequence [A, E, I, O, U] (wrapping around so U becomes A, A becomes E, etc.), preserving the original case.

3. If it is a number, space, punctuation mark, or any other symbol, leave it completely unchanged.
